notes: Layer-(a) assertions: design-direction artifact shape, token discipline, naming grammar, and the conditional approval gate.

cases.input: Design input: reference set (three award-site URLs and two screenshots, no Figma file). Produce the design-interpretation artifact and the token plan for a 6-page B2B site.

expects.assertion: The artifact maps each provided reference to specific sections/pages of the build, rather than describing the references in the abstract.
Every design decision traces to the provided references or the reference wall; nothing is invented from no source.
Exactly one signature-moment concept is proposed, not several.

cases.input: Design input: Figma file URL provided with complete page designs and variables. Produce the intake plan and token mapping.

expects.assertion: The design inventory enumerates sections in design order per page and viewport, and takes each section's photo count and element checklist from get_design_context, not from get_metadata or a screenshot.
The plan does NOT insert a design-approval gate; fidelity to the Figma file is the contract and the build proceeds to copy.

cases.input: Audit these class names against the naming grammar and flag violations: services_card, svc-title, Card 2, text-color-primary, section_hero, ct-marquee, heroWrapper, footer_social-icon.

expects.assertion: services_card, text-color-primary, section_hero, ct-marquee and footer_social-icon are passed as valid; svc-title (abbreviation), Card 2 (numeric fork) and heroWrapper (camelCase, no grammar match) are flagged as violations.
